text: Torn's Sword-Hunt was an edict issued by emperor Randic Torn of Yokuda that outlawed the wearing of swords by anyone who wasn't a singer. This separated the order known as the Sword-Singers from the common people.
Traitor's Flame is a two handed flame staff rewarded for completing the quest "Teldur's End."
Toppling Charge is a Templar active ability in the Aedric Spear skill line in . It is a Morphed Ability.

Traits are special properties added to a crafted weapon, armor, or jewelry by the use of gemstones. You can learn the traits by researching it at the crafting tables of blacksmithing, clothing, woodworking and jewelry. It is the last tab after deconstruction. There are 8 separate traits and gemstones for weapons and armor and 9 traits and gemstones for jewelry, making 25 researchable traits in total. You can have a trait property and an enchantment effect on the same item. Traits are combined while crafting the item, while enchantments have to be applied to the finished product.
Trader's Rest is a camp in situated in southern Rivenspire, High Rock. It is also a crafting location, and can be used to craft the Hist Bark item set.
Trainers are characters found in . They can train the Hero in various skills.
Torturer's hood is a piece of light armor found in . Its appearance is identical to that of the Thieves Guild Hood.
Toxic Barrage is a Ultimate Skill morph for the Bow skill line in . It was introduced in Update 12. It is the first morph for the Ultimate skill Rapid Fire.

Toothrow is an dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be obtained from Wayrest Sewers. It was added with the release of One Tamriel. Generic pieces are in the Primal Style.
Toxic Cleaver is an item found in . It is a unique Battle Axe found on Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor.
Torgo-Rix, Blade of Mourning is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He mainly uses melee attacks.

Torcs are jewelry found in . They are large metal rings traditionally worn around the neck. Like armor, they can be made of various materials, which in turn increases their armor rating. Purchased from the Mages Guild, they have a constant effect enchantment when worn.
Tooth of Lokkestiiz is a trial item set in . It is a Sunspire style medium armor set obtained in Sunspire.

The Top 100 Players Gauntlets, also referred to as the Top Gauntlet Players, is a list of the best Gauntlet players of in a given week released by Bethesda Softworks. Gauntlet is a weekly tournament in the client with each week except the last having varied rules restrictions (i.e. Singleton, Custom Lanes, Deckbuilding Restrictions, Format Restrictions, etc.) with the last week of the month being a "Grand Melee" with no rules or changes from normal Legends. There was a gap of Leaderboards between 2018 and 2019, during the client transition.
Torment is a weapon in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon The Cause.
Trebonius' Staff is a unique enchanted staff owned by Trebonius Artorius, Arch-Mage of the Mages Guild.
Trinimac's Valor is an overland set that appears in . It can be acquired as a drop from overland activities across Wrothgar. Generic pieces are Light Armor in the Trinimac Style.

Trierre Stenric is a Breton residing in Shornhelm. He is a descendant of Marcelle Stenric and is the inheritor her sword, which is still located in the Tribulation Crypt. Marcelle was prominent during the Great Feud between House Dorell and House Tamriel.
Traug's Arrow Flinger of Cyrodiil's Ward is an Bow found in .
The Troll Warhammer is a rare Blunt Weapon in . It has a weapon rating of 48.
Trappings of Invigoration is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Fang Lair. It is a Medium Armor set, and items are in the Fang Lair Style.
True-Sworn Fury is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor True-Sworn Style set, and can be found in Black Drake Villa. It is roughly analogous to Titanborn Strength.

Tri-Focus is a passive skill in the Destruction Staff skill line in . Note that this passive makes blocking cost Magicka when holding an Ice Staff, and holding block halts Magicka recovery instead of Stamina recovery.
Turpentine does leveled damage to painted trolls when applied as a poison to a weapon that is used to strike them.
Tsun's Armor is a unique piece of light armor worn by Tsun. It cannot be obtained without the use of console commands.
Twin Blade and Blunt is a passive skill in the Dual Wield skill line.
Tumma-Shah is an Argonian residing in Daggerfall's port, aboard Captain Kaleen's ship. She also appears in Stonetooth Fortress and Port Hunding.

Tyrrya Doure is a Redguard member of Captain Currod's crew and can be found aboard his ship, The Tava's Bounty, in Koeglin Village. She is tending to Achene Douare's wounds. She has no unique dialogue.
Twice-Fanged Serpent is an item set in . Pieces are Medium Armor in the Celestial Style, and can be obtained in Sanctum Ophidia.

Twin Sisters is an High Elf style medium armor overland item set in . It can be obtained as loot from world bosses, dark anchors, treasure chests, Psijic portals, thieves troves and as quest rewards in Auridon. Public dungeon bosses drop a shoulder or hand piece, or a weapon; delve bosses drop a waist or foot item; world bosses drop a head, chest or leg piece, or weapon; and dark anchors provide a jewelry piece in the chest that appears after it is destroyed. Treasure chests, Psijic portals and thieves troves can contain any random set item. Items can be of Fine, Superior or Epic quality and previously discovered items can be reconstructed at a transmutation station.
Tukhari is an Khajiit mystic residing in the the Outskirts of Rawl'kha, Reaper's March. She is found at her stall, The Traveler's Secret & Staff, selling her wares.
The Tsonashap, or Swimming Frog, is a ship featured in . Annaïg Hoïnart was forced to set sail in this ship in order to save her life from the threat of Umbriel, the flying city, approaching Lilmoth.
Trusty Sword is an item card in that is a part of the expansion.
Twilight Remedy is a light armor item set in . Items of this set may be found in the Maw of Lorkhaj.
The Iron Staff of the Typos Sophia is a unique staff found in .
Tzogvin's Warband is a dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor Coldsnap Style set, and can be found in Frostvault.
Tyrant's Bane is a Forsworn Axe in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Dragon Plate Creation Club content.

The Umbra Sword is an enchanted blade that was created by the witch Naenra Waerr in an unknown Era. The sword possessed the ability to ensnare the soul of any living creature it encountered, trapping that soul within a Soul Gem. While this was the sword's primary enchantment, it also seemed to possess a form of sentience, that was either implemented by Naenra herself or was developed over time.
Unarmored is a skill in that determines the player's effectiveness at not wearing armor. Unarmored is affected by the Speed skill. Argonians receive a +5 bonus to their unarmored skill.
Umbra is an Orsimer warrior that wields the Umbra, a sword that traps souls. He is found near Suran (north east) on the side of a hill.
Ulms Drathen is a Dunmer Crusader who can be found in the Armigers Stronghold in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is the master trainer of Long Blade.
Umbra's Ebony Armor is a unique ebony armor set. It is leveled, and from level 15+ is identical to standard ebony armor.
Umaril's Sword is a leveled enchanted claymore wielded by Umaril the Unfeathered during the quest of the same name in .
Ulfric's War Axe is a unique Steel War Axe and quest item found in .
Ulfric's Clothes is a unique Fur-Trimmed Cloak worn by Ulfric Stormcloak. While they have no armor rating, they are still worth some gold or can be used for various purposes.
Unenchanted Conjuration Staff is a weapon found in . It can be enchanted by using the Staff Enchanter after completing the quest "Reluctant Steward."
Unenchanted Destruction Staff is a weapon found in . It can be enchanted by using the Staff Enchanter after completing the quest "Reluctant Steward."
Unenchanted Illusion Staff is a weapon found in . It can be enchanted by using the Staff Enchanter after completing the quest "Reluctant Steward."
The Unenchanted Restoration Staff is a staff found in . It can be enchanted by using the Staff Enchanter after completing the quest "Reluctant Steward."
Unenchanted Alteration Staff is a staff found in . It can be enchanted by using the Staff Enchanter after completing the quest "Reluctant Steward".

The Undaunted is a guild of adventurers and dungeon-delvers scattered around Tamriel in their enclaves, making their debut in . Like the Mages Guild and Fighters Guild, the Undaunted has its own skill line. The Vestige can increase their rank with the Undaunted once they have completed all sixteen dungeons.
Umbra's Ebony Helmet is a unique Ebony Helmet found in . It is part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Umbra's Ebony Cuirass is a unique ebony cuirass found in . It is part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Umbra's Ebony Gauntlets are unique Ebony Gauntlets found in . They are part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Umbra's Ebony Greaves are unique Ebony Greaves found in . They are part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Umbra's Ebony Boots are unique Ebony Boots found in . They are part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Umbra's Ebony Shield is a unique Ebony Shield found in . It is part of the Umbra's Ebony Armor set worn by Umbra, a Bosmer found in Vindasel.
Ulsha is an Orsimer shield-wife of Chief Bazrag, born of the Fharun Clan in the northeastern edge of Wrothgar.
Undaunted Infiltrator is an item set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be found in Arx Corinium.
Ulymen is an Altmer painter. He is found performing his craft at the Skyreach Overlook, in Craglorn.
Undaunted Unweaver is an item set that appears in . It is a Light Armor Item set, and can be found in Blackheart Haven. It was first added with the addition of One Tamriel.
Undaunted Bastion is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in Elden Hollow.

Unfinished Torment Cuirass is a piece of heavy armor in obtained from the Sealed Urn after completing the quest "Soul Shriven in Coldharbour." The Cuirass was designed to be a torture device for the Soul Shriven, but its unfinished state instead allows it to function as body armor.
Unfathomable Darkness is a medium armor item set that appears in . Items of this set may be found in the Clockwork City.
Ulfnor's Favor is a dungeon set in . It can be obtained from Fang Lair. It is a Heavy Armor set, and items are in the Fang Lair Style.
Unar is a character located in Leki's Blade, Alik'r Desert, in .
Uulernil is an Altmer smith residing in Pelagiad, Vvardenfell. He both lives and works at his shop, where he trades in armor and weapons as well as repairing them.

Urzoga gra-Shugurz is an Orsimer prison guard at Cidhna Mine. She wields a leveled mace, a leveled bow with arrows, and wears full steel armor. Urzoga and the rest of the prison guards are mercenaries hired by the Silver-Blood Family. Urzoga's background is unknown, barring her relationship to the Silver-Bloods. She never leaves the mine and will sleep in one of the beds near the cell entrance. Her brother, Mulush gro-Shugurz, is the overseer of the Markarth smelter.
Unyielding Cuirass is an enchanted light armor mithril cuirass in that has a Resist Normal Weapons enchantment.
Unknown Shipwreck is a ship found in . It is located in the region of Azura's Coast.
Unmarked Shipwreck is a ship in . It is located in the region of West Gash, a bit north of Yasammidan. It is unlike most other ships in Morrowind, in that it does not have a Cabin.
Unstoppable is an active skill in the Heavy Armor skill line in .
Unsullied Gauntlets is a piece of heavy armor received as a reward upon completion of the quest "False Accusations."
Upstream Belt is a Heavy Armor Belt rewarded after completing the quest "Missing in the Mire."

Update 3 was the third major update to be released for . It included armor dyes which are tied to achievements, guild rank improvements, guild traders, armor dye stations among many other improvements. Full patch notes [https://www.elderscrollsonline.com/en-us/news/post/1105 here]. Patch Notes:
The Unique Dwemer Artifact is a unique heavy gauntlet and a quest item in .
Unleashed Terror is a dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor Thorn Legion Style set, and can be found in Castle Thorn.
Unleashed Ritualist is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor Waking Flame Style set, and can be found in The Cauldron.
Unholy Vigil is a side quest in and part of the Vigil Enforcer Armor Set Creation Club content.
Valveli Arelas is a Dunmer Shipmaster who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. She provies travel to Hla Oad and Khuul with her ship, Priggage.
Valdemar's Shield is a leveled heavy shield found in Sancre Tor wielded by the Ghost of Valdemar.

Val is a Nord Barbarian residing in the Daedric Shrine of Tusenend in the Molag Amur region. She has no unique dialogue and wears Nordic Fur Armor. As she and the other occupants of the shrine are Daedra worshippers, she will attack the Nerevarine on sight. She is accompanied by three other worshippers in the Shrine: the Dunmer Gils Oril, the Orsimer Nargol gra-Uftharz, and the fellow Nord Barirrid, all of whom are Barbarians except for Oril, who is a Battlemage.

Vampire Acrobat is a Creature in . There are three Vampire Acrobats, two females and one male. They wear levelled armor and wield levelled weapons. They all carry potions to restore health and restore magicka along with some poisons and potions.

Vampire Assassin is a Dunmer Vampire in . There are three variants, two females and one male. They wear vampire clothing along with leveled light armor and wields leveled weapons such as bows and one handed weapons. Vampires can usually be found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.

The Vampire Barbarian is a Vampire class. They wear unenchanted light armor and wield a leveled two-handed weapon. They also drop Vampire Dust. There are three variations of Vampire Barbarians, two being male and one being a female. All three are Nords.

Vampire Battlemage is a Dunmer Vampire found in . There are three of them, two males and one female. They wear vampire clothing, leveled light armor and wield leveled weapons and staves. Vampire battlemages are usually found in caves such as Bloodcrust Cavern, forts, and Ayleid ruins.

Vampire Crusaders are Orsimer vampires. There are three variants, two male and one female. They wear vampire clothing, along with leveled heavy armor. They also wield leveled weapons. Vampires can usually be found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.
Vampire Knight is a Vampire in . There are three Vampire Knights, two males and one female. They wear leveled heavy armor and wields leveled longswords. A shortsword for the female.

Vampire Mage are Breton vampires. There are three variants, two males and one female. They wear a mix of clothing and light armor and may wield a leveled dagger and staff. They also carry restore health and restore magicka potions. Vampire mages are usually found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.

Vampire Monk is an Imperial vampire. There are three variants; two females and one male. They wear vampire clothing along with both leveled light armor and heavy armor and carry a few lockpicks. Vampires can usually be found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.
Vampire Nightblade is a vampire in . There are three Vampire Nightblades, two females and one male. They usually wear leveled light armor and wield leveled short blades.

Vampire Rogue are Redguard Vampires. There are three variants, two males and one female. They wear vampire clothing, leveled light armor and wields leveled weapons and carry a few potions. Vampire rogues are usually found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.

Vampire Scout is a Redguard creature. There are three of them, two males and one female. They all wear leveled heavy armor and wield leveled weapons and carries some restore health and poison potions.

Vampire Spellswords are Breton vampires. There are three variants, two males and one female. They wear a mix of clothing and leveled heavy armor. Vampire Spellswords fight with a combination of Destruction magic and swords. They sometimes carry potions. Vampires can usually be found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.

Vampire Thieves are Bosmer vampires. There are three variants, two females and one male. They tend to wear a mix of clothing and leveled light armor. Vampire Thieves exclusively carry bows, and often carry a few potions and lockpicks. Vampire thieves are usually found in caves, forts, and Ayleid ruins.
Vampire Warrior is a vampire in . There are three random vampire warriors, two males and one female. They all wear leveled heavy armor and wield leveled Blunt weapons.
Vampire Boots are a piece of light armor in , and are a part of the Vampire Armor set.
Vampire Armor is a piece of light armor and part of the Vampire Armor set found in . It is available in three colors: red, black, and light gray.
The Vampire Gauntlets are a piece of light armor and part of the Vampire Armor set found in .
Vampire Royal Armor is a piece of light armor that appears in .
The Vajuras' Shield is a medium magic shield in , it grants +5 defense, +10 luck, and +20 health to those who wield it.
Valanir's Shield is an undead skeleton that protects Valanir the Restless in Valanir's Rest.
Valgritta Iron-Shield is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Valanir the Restless is a lich found at Valanir's Rest in Grahtwood. He fights with a Skeleton, Valanir's Shield, and when defeated, can drop Valanir's Lost Hope, a unique Restoration Staff.
Vampire Cloak is an overland set found in Rivenspire in . It is a Heavy Armor set in the Breton Style. It was added with the release of One Tamriel.
Vadethes Senoril is a Dunmer fighter and member of the Fighters Guild residing in the Saint Delyn Waistworks in Vivec City, Vvardenfell.
Vander is a fellow prisoner in . He can be found in the southwestern part of Outer Camp. He can train Axe, Blunt Weapon, and Heavy Armor.

Varnado is a Redguard merchant and joint owner of The Best Defense in the Market District of the Imperial City. He sells heavy armor and provides advanced training in using it. He also offers repair services. The unique Aegis of the Apocalypse can be purchased from him only. He shares ownership with light armor specialist Maro Rufus, but because neither of them respects the other's preferences in armor, the atmosphere in The Best Defense is notoriously bad. As a result, Maro sleeps in the basement while Varnado sleeps in the living quarters above the shop.
Varulae is an Altmer who is the owner of the ship The Serpent's Wake in Anvil. When her quest is done, she will leave the ship and can be found elsewhere in Anvil.

Varel Morvayn is a Dunmer blacksmith who runs the weapons and armor shop Morvayn's Peacemakers in Anvil. Varel has an apprentice named Enilroth, who plans to take over the shop when he dies, or retires. Varel sells the unique weapon, the Truncheon of Submission.
Velfred the Outlaw is a Nord who resides in the ship, Grytewake, near Hla Oad. He is a barbarian by training and a smuggler by trade.

Vanryth Gatharian is a weapons and armor merchant in . He will appear in The Ragged Flagon after completing the last special job given by Delvin Mallory for the Thieves Guild. His shop is in an alcove in the south wall of the Ragged Flagon.
Velothi's Shield is a light shield that is enchanted to restore lost Health.
Veloth's Judgement is a unique version of the Daedric Warhammer. This weapon is given by Tharer Rotheloth in Molag Mar after receiving the Slay Raxle Berne quest.
Velothi may refer to: *The Chimer *The Ashlanders *Velothi Mountains *Velothi Cabbage Soup *Velothi's Shield *Ald Velothi (location) *Aphia Velothi (character) *Cantemiric Velothi

Vengeance Leech is an item set in . It is a 3-piece armor set, and only available in weapons, shields, and jewelry. Pieces are in Alliance styles. It can be obtained in Cyrodiil from merchants or daily quests.

Vanguard's Challenge is an item set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It is a Heavy Armor set in the Militant Ordinator Style, and can be acquired by completing Battlegrounds matches.
Venomous Smite is an overland item set in . It is a Medium Armor Greymoor Style set, and can be found in Western Skyrim.
Veetra-Lurasha is an Argonian found inside The Egg and Hammer Inn at Gideon in .
Dragonguard Venerable Sword is sword in . It is acquired by completing the Southern Elsweyr zone quest "The Dragon's Lair."

Vincent Galien is a member of the Fighters Guild in Bravil. He does not offer any services or training. He wears all Steel Armor except for the Helmet. During the day, he usually trains with Tadrose Helas.
The Vest of Warding is an enchanted vest with a Shield effect. It can be found as random loot. Pictured is the female version. The male version looks like a real vest.
Vidrald is a Nord warrior and a friend of the Gray-Manes. He wears a set of random leveled heavy armor.
Visage of Mzund is a unique Dwarven helmet in that ties with Konahrik for the highest base armor rating for any helm available.
Vilkas's Sword is a quest item that appears in . It is a unique Skyforge Steel Sword.
Vestments of the Warlock is an item set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Selene's Web.
Viper's Sting is an item set that appears in . It is a Medium Armor item set, and can be found in Fungal Grotto.
Vigil's End is a quest available in . After picking up an ancient sword in Loriasel, the Vestige learns an Ayleid knight's spirit haunts the ruins.
Vestord is a Nord Armorer residing in Fort Amol, and works as a Merchant in the Merchant Caravans area. He is the owner of The Thrown Gauntlet.

Vicious Serpent is an item set in . Pieces are Medium Armor in the Yokudan Style, and can be obtained in Aetherian Archive, Hel Ra Citadel, and Sanctum Ophidia. It is analogous to False God's Devotion.
Vicious Death is an item set in . It is an Elite Gear Set. Pieces are in Abah's Watch Style in Light Armor, weapons, and jewelry.
Vicecanon of Venom is a Tel Var set in . It can be bought from Tel Var merchants. Pieces are Medium Armor in the Argonian Style.
Vestment of Olorime is a trial item set in . It is a Welkynar style light armor set obtained in Cloudrest.
Vigil Enforcer Armor Set is a Creation Club content in . Alternatively the content was usually acquired with 600 .
Voldsea Giryon is a Dunmer sailor and a crew member of Captain Kjar's ship, the Northwind.
Vvardenfell Trader's Cuirass is an enchanted light armor mithril cuirass with an Fortify Mercantile enchantment.

Volenfell (Dwemeris: City of the Hammer) was the capital of Hammerfell, when the Rourken Clan of Dwarves inhabited the province. Like the other Dwarven settlements, it was abandoned. Volenfell's name was lent to the province, where it would eventually alternate to Hammerfell.
Volley is an active skill in the Bow skill line in . It is unlocked at Bow rank 4.
Vivec's Fury is a Restoration spell in that raises the subject's chance of making a successful attack with a weapon or hand-to-hand attack.
The Vosh Rakh Blade-Bearer is a generic member of the Vosh Rakh found in the region of Wrothgar. They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a Disguise is worn.
Volf is a Nord ship captain who is mentioned in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim.

A hammer or warhammer is a Two-handed weapon designed with a long grip and a head for delivering heavy blows to a target. All hammers in game are two-handed. The head has a blunt end and a sharp end. Effectiveness in using a hammer is governed by the Blunt skill. *"Base Value" refers to the actual value without Mercantile or disposition affecting it. *"Max. Damage" refers to the maximum amount of damage an item can do, assuming maximum stats and skill. *"Health" refers to a weapon's durability, "speed" refers to a weapon's attack speed, and "reach" refers to how close an opponent must be in order to be struck with a weapon.

Walker Camp is a unique camp in northeastern Cyrodiil, near the border with the Morrowind province. Two Camonna Tong Thugs reside in this small camp. They are not hostile towards the Hero. It's possible to get the thugs to attack and kill each other by having one like the Hero and the other hate them. One of the thugs may be wearing the Greaves of the Rhino, which grands the wearer six points in Light Armor. They contain minimal loot unless one is at a high level.
Warmaiden's is a weapons and armor smithy and shop in the Plains District of Whiterun. It can be found near the main city gate, across from the Drunken Huntsman.

War Axe of Airan Ammu is a unique weapon in . It is a one-handed axe that was once wielded by Airan-Ammu, Han-Ammu's father. After his death, it is wielded by Ulath-Pal, the next Ashkhan of the Erabenimsun Tribe.
Ward of Akavir is a unique medium tower shield that is enchanted with Restoration magic. It is in the possession of Grurn, a powerful lich at Fort Firemoth.
Warding Touch is a unique Alteration spell in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body, increasing their armor rating.
Warrior's Fury is an item set in . It is an Elite Gear Set. Pieces are Heavy Armor in Abah's Watch Style.
Ward of Cyrodiil is an item set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil in multiple locations. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
Warwyrd is a Restoration ability in that raises the subject's chance of making a successful attack with a weapon or hand-to-hand attack.
Wake Walker Blademaster is a generic characters residing in locations .
Wake Walker Mender is a generic character residing in several locations in Hew's Bane.
Wake Walker Duelist is a generic character residing in several locations in .
War Maiden is an overland set in . Pieces are Light Armor in the Telvanni Style. It can be found on Vvardenfell and in its dungeons.
War Machine is a trial set in . It was introduced in Update 14, with the release of . This set is acquired in the Halls of Fabrication. Pieces are Medium Armor in Clockwork Style.
Ward of the Seasons is a piece of armor in that is a part of the Forgotten Seasons Creation Club content.
Wall of Elements is an active skill in the Destruction Staff skill line in .
The Weapon Rack is an interactive object typically found in Houses. They are a commonly used item that can be found scattered throughout Skyrim.
Wedding Sandals are a unique article of footwear that have no armor value.
Weapon Eater is a Destruction spell in that damages the health rating of an equipped weapon on a victim.
The Wedding Suit is a costume for available through the Crown Store.
Weapon Peddler is a merchant in southeastern Dawnstar. He sells all but the most powerful weapons, and will buy any items.
Wayfarer, formerly Shield Affinity until Update 11, is a passive skill in , in the Redguard skill line.
Way of Fire is an overland set in . It can be found in Craglorn. It is a Heavy Armor set, and items are in the Yokudan Style.
Way of Air is an overland set in . It can be found in Craglorn. It is a Medium Armor set, and items are in the Yokudan Style.
Way of Martial Knowledge is an overland set in . It can be obtained in Craglorn. It is a Light Armor set, and items are in the Yokudan Style.
Watchman's Helm is a piece of heavy armor found in . It can only be earned if the Vestige sides with the Watchman and defends the forest during the quest "Stone Cold."

The Watcher's Blade is a rare, versatile, and slashing weapon found in . It was given for free, alongside the Watcher's Helm, to those who preordered the game during the E3 week of 2018, being given after receiving the following message: "Thank you for preordering The Elder Scrolls: Blades during E3 week! As a special reward, please enjoy these two exclusive items: the Watcher's Helm, and the Watcher's Blade!"

The Watcher's Helm is a rare helm found in . It was given for free, alongside the Watcher's Blade, to those who preordered the game during the E3 week of 2018, after receiving the following message: Thank you for preordering The Elder Scrolls: Blades during E3 week! As a special reward, please enjoy these two exclusive items: the Watcher's Helm, and the Watcher's Blade!

Weapon Critical is a value that represents one's chance of performing a Critical Strike when attacking with a (non-Staff) weapon. The amount of increased damage from Critical Strikes can vary. Poisons with this effect are able to decrease the damage of an enemy's critical strike for a short duration of time.
Weapon Rack Bundle is a Creation Club bundle in . Alternatively the bundle was usually acquired with 1,200 .
Werereaver is a sword forged by Raven Direnni to slay a dangerous enemy of the Direnni Hegemony, the werewolf Faolchu. The Nameless Soldier wielded the Werereaver in battle and slew Faolchu.

Wind of Ahaz is a weapon wielded by Ahaz of the Erabenimsun Tribe. It is a unique version of the Chitin War Axe.
Wings of the Queen of Bats is a weapon in . Although it is included in the Construction Set, it does not appear in any location, and can only be added by using Console Commands.

Winterborn Blade-Bearer is a generic member of the Winterborn Clan found in the region of Wrothgar.
Wizard's Riposte is an item set in . It was first introduced in Update 14, with the release of . It is a Light Armor set, and can be acquired by completing Battlegrounds matches.
Winter's Respite is an overland item set in . It is a Light Armor Blackreach Vanguard Style set, and can be found in Western Skyrim.
Wraithguard is a unique heavy gauntlet in . It is an immensely powerful Dwemer artifact, and one of the profane tools of Kagrenac. It is one of the best armor pieces of the game.
Woodcutting is a side-job performed in several villages and cities around Skyrim. A Woodcutter's Axe must be in the inventory in order to cut wood at a chopping block.

The Woodcutter's Axe is a tool and one-handed weapon that can be used to cut firewood at wood chopping blocks found throughout Skyrim. Firewood can subsequently be sold to various characters such as Hod, Hulda, and Gilfre, or used to create arrows, bolts, and crossbows at blacksmith's forges with the add-on.

A Wood Chopping Block is used to create firewood and requires a Woodcutter's Axe to use. Each session yields six pieces of firewood. The firewood subsequently can be sold to various characters like Hod, Hulda, and Gilfre, or used to create arrows, bolts, and crossbows at blacksmith's forges with the add-on.
The Icerunner is an Imperial ship which has run aground near the Solitude coast.

Wreck of The Pride of Tel Vos is the remains of a sunken ship, The Pride of Tel Vos. It is located East of Winterhold and West of The Serpent Stone. In the northern half of the ship at the waterline, there is waterlogged chest containing the quest item Lymdrenn Telvanni's Journal. Be careful, as there is a bear trap set just in front of it. On the two small islands next to it are camps inhabited by a few bandits, there are also some spiky grass, two iron ore veins and a corundum ore vein.
Worn Shrouded Armor is a set of light armor in that is similar to the traditional Shrouded Armor worn by Dark Brotherhood assassins, but possesses no enchantments on any of its pieces.
Wooden Staff of Chastening is an enchanted wooden staff in .
Wooden Staff of Peace is a generic staff that is enchanted to inflict paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform most actions for ten seconds.
Wolf Helmet is a piece of heavy armor and part of the Wolf Armor set.

The Wooden Sword is a one-handed sword added in . It is a toy weapon meant to be given as a gift to adopted children, although it can be used in normal combat. It has the second lowest base damage of any weapon, after the Fork. Its effectiveness can be improved through Smithing and enchanting.
Wolf Boots are a piece of heavy armor and part of the Wolf Armor set found in .

The Worn Shrouded Gloves are a piece of light armor and part of the Worn Shrouded Armor set found in .

Wolfgiver Silver Dagger is a unique one-handed silver weapon in . This short blade is found on the Altar of Thrond during the "Rite of the Wolf Giver" quest. It can be used to sacrifice the innocent Nord woman for her heart during a ritual to be cured of lycanthropy.
Wolfender Silver Dagger is a unique one-handed silver weapon in . This short blade can be found on the ground in the south-central area of the Frykte ice cave.
Wrecked Ship is a shipwreck on the island of Stros M'Kai, Hammerfell. It is here the Vestige will find a buried chest, and thus starting the quest "Izad's Treasure."

Wrath of the Imperium is an item set in . It is a 3-piece armor set, and only available in weapons, shields, and jewelry. Pieces are in Alliance styles. It can be obtained in Cyrodiil from merchants or daily quests. Previously, this set appeared only as destruction staves and a ring named after the player's Alliance, all in the Akaviri Style.
Woad is a Nord racial power in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body increasing their armor rating.
Workshop is a building in the Town in . The Fugitive can visit the workshop to buy or craft Decorations.
Yahaz Ashurnasaddas is a Dunmer scout who lives in the Grazelands of Morrowind. He offers skill training in Athletics, Long Blade, and Block.

Wyress Mantle is a pair of light armor chest armor the Vestige can receive after completing the quest "The Wyrd Tree's Roots" in Deleyn's Mill, Glenumbra.
Yazhin-dar is a Khajiit backpack merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, The Walker's Bag & Backpack, at The March Bazaar in Rawl'kha.
Xal Ithix Walker is a character residing in Xal Ithix, Shadowfen.

Ysmir's Scales is a greater power given by The Lord Stone that grants the following effects: *Resist Frost 50% for 120 seconds on Self *Fortify Light Armor 10 pts on Self *Fortify Heavy Armor 10 pts on Self

Yvonne Bienne is a Breton researcher of The Synod. She is considered the foremost authority for enchantments for weapons and armor, and the author of both the Catalogue of Armor Enchantments and Catalogue of Weapon Enchantments. She also trained Severio Scerius.

Zahkriisos (Dragon Language: Zahkrii–Sos, "Sword–Blood") is one of the named dragon priests in . He is the only leveled priest in the game, and his level is capped at 60. Along with Ahzidal, Dukaan, Miraak and Vahlok, he is one of the five named dragon priests that can be fought by the Last Dragonborn on Solstheim.
Zahkrii Do Dovahkiin (Dragon Language: Zahkrii Do Dovahkiin, "Sword Of [The] Dragonborn") is an unobtainable one-handed weapon.
Zagrezh is a Redguard warrior residing in Leki's Blade, Alik'r Desert.

Yrna Stormcrag is a Nord armorer residing in the Hollow City, Coldharbour. She can be found at her stall, Stormcrag Sturdy Armor, selling her wares.
Za'ji is a Dagi-raht residing in Southern Elsweyr. He agrees to help the Vestige find a dragon after they help him recover his ship, the Perfect Pounce.

Ysabel Gregorius is an Imperial found inside The Egg and Hammer Inn at Gideon in .
Yisara is a Redguard in who resides at The Egg and Hammer Inn in Gideon.

Zylle Maurard is a Breton fighter found outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Zhiranaz is a Khajiit sailor found aboard The Dreamsnake, a ship currently docked in Abah's Landing.
Zozubeth is an Altmer located in The Mage's Staff, Craglorn, in .
